parameters.jsCode:
const p = $('Collect Results').first().json;
let ins = {};
try { const c = $('Insight').first().json; const t = (c.candidates[0].content.parts||[]).map(p=>p.text||'').join(''); ins = JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) {}
const reportMd = '# Campaign Report

'
  + 'Published: ' + ((p.published||[]).map(x=>x.label+(x.via?(' ('+x.via+')'):'')+(x.url?(' '+x.url):'')).join('; ') || 'none') + '

'
  + (p.staged&&p.staged.length ? ('Staged: ' + p.staged.map(x=>x.label+' - '+x.reason).join('; ') + '

') : '')
  + (p.errors&&p.errors.length ? ('Errors: ' + p.errors.map(x=>x.label+': '+x.error).join('; ') + '

') : '')
  + (p.brollPlans&&p.brollPlans.length ? ('B-roll plan (dryRun):
' + p.brollPlans.map(b =>
      '- ' + b.label + ': ~' + b.estDurationSec + 's, ~' + b.brollCoveragePct + '% b-roll / ~' + b.avatarPct
      + '% avatar, ' + b.clips + ' Pexels clips from ' + b.beats + ' beats
'
      + b.queries.map((x,i)=>'   ' + (i+1) + '. ' + x).join('
')).join('
') + '

') : '')
  + 'Performance: ' + (ins.performanceSummary||'') + '

'
  + 'Projection: ' + (ins.projection||'') + '

'
  + 'Next: ' + (ins.nextStep||'');
const base = String(p.originalContribution||'').split('
# Campaign Report')[0].trim();
// keep the per-channel result lines appended by cmo-video / blog runs (they live after the report)
const keep = (String(p.originalContribution||'').match(/^- \[[a-z]+\][^
]*$/gm) || []).join('
');
return [{ json: { newContribution: base + '

---

' + reportMd + (keep ? '

' + keep : ''), goalId: p.goalId } }];
